name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Press
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and clean a light kettlebell so it balances upside down over your clenched fist at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and glutes, pack your shoulder down, and align your elbow directly beneath your wrist.
Press the inverted kettlebell smoothly straight overhead while crushing the handle to keep the bell vertical.
Lower the bell slowly back to shoulder height under control, then switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Squeeze the handle tightly and keep your forearm vertical so the inverted bell stays balanced over your wrist.
Start with a lighter weight than your regular overhead press and stay ready to clear the bell safely if balance slips.
